ideas_lead: Whichever city you pick, the rest of the day can cost less too. One real find in each other category, each from its own page and dated.

faq.q: What would be considered a micro wedding?
faq.a: There is no official cutoff, so we use each venue's own words: the guest limits printed next to the 41 prices on our city pages run from 2 to 175 people. Every venue listed prints its price for a small, micro, weekday or elopement booking.

faq.q: What is a normal cost for a wedding venue?
faq.a: We do not quote an average, because an average hides what each venue prints. Across 5 cities the verified prices run from $197 (The Courthouse Wedding Chapel, Houston) to $8,900 (County Line Event Center, Houston), each from the venue's own website on Oct 28, 2026.

Not by the venues on this page: the largest guest limit printed next to a price here is 175 people. Venues that host 100 guests price a different kind of day, so we list them only when they print a small-group price.

faq.q: What is a realistic budget for a small wedding?
faq.a: For the venue alone, the prices we verified run from $197 to $8,900. The rest depends on you; our city pages add one real find each for the dress, flowers and photos so you can see how the lines add up.

For a small group it can be: all 41 venue prices on our city pages are $8,900 or less, before the dress, flowers, photos and food. A 100-guest wedding is a different budget, because these pages price small groups only.
